assessment_basis: Valid type-safe alternative under the class tree invariant. getVertices calls getTree(true) on internal nodes before computeGeometricalProperties examines the attribute, causing null internal attributes to become BoundaryAttribute objects; malformed Boolean internal attributes already fail during vertex building in both versions. Therefore a successful empty-vertices path has Boolean attributes only for leaves. The instanceof Boolean test distinguishes the same whole-space leaf case as the reference getCut()==null guard. Recompiled full PolygonsSet checks match for all four leaf masks, inside/outside leaves and five finite boxes. Spectrum was already supported; only LLM/combined are newly resolved.
